path_step: Teacher revokes a student's intervention permission
test_scenario: Verify that a Teacher can revoke a student's permission to speak during a live video session.
test_case_title: Verify teacher can revoke student intervention
pre_condition: Teacher and Student are logged in, enrolled in the course, have joined an active video session, and the Student has been granted permission to speak by the Teacher.
expected_result: The student's audio/video broadcast stops, and the teacher's list of intervention requests reflects the revoked status. The main video view reverts to the teacher/previous presenter.
post_condition: Student's speaking permission is revoked, and their broadcast stops.

test_steps.step: Student clicks the 'Ask for Intervention' button.
Teacher grants intervention permission to the student.
Student verifies their audio/video is broadcasting.
Teacher navigates to the list of intervention requests.
Teacher clicks to 'Revoke' the student's intervention request.
Student verifies their audio/video broadcast stops.
Teacher verifies the student is no longer broadcasting and their request status is updated.

uncovered_conditions: Teacher-Specific Actions: 3 (Teacher can revoke a student's intervention request)
Business Rule: BR-VIDEO-02 (The teacher has the authority to grant or revoke a student's permission to speak at any time)
